scope: Whole sample EUR portfolio. Both funds are equities; no individual fund targets. Incoming contributions are outside until deposited.
review_trigger: Annual review, not a requirement to trade. Keeping the portfolio unchanged is a valid baseline if its rules still hold.
preference: Compare buying underweights with available new cash first. Preserve the cash reserve; do not sell merely to improve a displayed score. Preference is conditional on feasibility and the investor choice.
calculation_assumptions: Value each fund sleeve by its observed total-return-series ratio, then round the modeled value to EUR cents. These are not observed customer holdings.
Both series are EUR listings on the same two valuation dates. Do not mix listings or currencies.
Cash earns zero interest in the illustration; no interim contributions or withdrawals. These are scenario assumptions, not observations.
Dollar/euro proposal amounts are gross comparisons before fees, bid/ask spread and taxes. Cost basis, tax jurisdiction and broker execution rules are not supplied.
Do not derive an executable share quantity from adjusted total-return series values. No current execution quote or confirmed fractional-share support is provided.
Cash injected from outside the portfolio changes the denominator before identifying underweights. A contribution is not itself investment return.
A shortfall from exact targets is not automatically a breach of the tolerance bands. A plan within its bands does not mandate trading.
Targets apply to asset classes, not the individual equity funds. The comparison does not choose which fund to buy or sell. Gross notional amounts are not executable share quantities.
